name: core.openwop.connections.zendesk
description: Zendesk connection pack (RFC 0095) — OAuth2 (authorization-code, per-subdomain) provider for the Zendesk Ticketing REST API. ADR 0033 DEPLOY-GATED. Endpoints are per-tenant (https://{subdomain}.zendesk.com/oauth/…), so the pack carries an instanceUrlTemplate and no fixed endpoints — the host resolves them from the connected subdomain (the NetSuite precedent). Reach is `openapi` against Zendesk's documented Ticketing API: no first-party hosted MCP server, so the documented REST surface is the honest day-1 reach (ADR 0033 §4). Zendesk was the top helpdesk absence vs the market-standard app surface in the ADR 0190 template research. Carries NO secret; the operator supplies the OAuth client id/secret host-side (ADR 0024 §7).
